scripts.install:hc: bash ./node_modules/@ddd-qc/hc-prebuilt/download-hc.sh holochain $npm_package_config_bin $npm_package_config_hc_version && bash ./node_modules/@ddd-qc/hc-prebuilt/download-hc.sh hc $npm_package_config_bin $npm_package_config_hc_version && bash ./node_modules/@ddd-qc/hc-prebuilt/download-hc.sh kitsune2-bootstrap-srv $npm_package_config_bin $npm_package_config_k2_version
scripts.build:zdk: cd submodules/zdk && RUSTFLAGS='--cfg getrandom_backend="custom"' CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
scripts.build:wasm: cd playgrounds && RUSTFLAGS='--cfg getrandom_backend="custom"' CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown
scripts.build:dna: npm run build:wasm && $npm_package_config_bin/hc dna pack --output=artifacts/named_real.dna playgrounds/workdirs/workdir_playground && $npm_package_config_bin/hc dna pack --output=artifacts/named_integer.dna playgrounds/workdirs/workdir_named_integer && $npm_package_config_bin/hc dna pack --output=artifacts/tasker.dna playgrounds/workdirs/workdir_tasker && npm run package:profiles
scripts.build:happ: npm run build:dna && $npm_package_config_bin/hc app pack --output=artifacts/playground.happ playgrounds/workdirs/workdir_playground
scripts.build:happ:clone: npm run build:dna && $npm_package_config_bin/hc app pack --output=artifacts/playground-clone.happ playgrounds/workdirs/workdir_clone
scripts.build:happ:tasker: npm run build:dna && $npm_package_config_bin/hc app pack --output=artifacts/tasker.happ playgrounds/workdirs/workdir_tasker
scripts.build:shared-ownership: bash scripts/ts-bindings.sh && npm run build -w dvms/shared-ownership
scripts.build:agent-directory: bash scripts/ts-bindings.sh && npm run build -w dvms/agent-directory
scripts.build:path-explorer: bash scripts/ts-bindings.sh && npm run build -w dvms/path-explorer
scripts.build:profiles: bash scripts/ts-bindings.sh && npm run build -w dvms/profiles
scripts.build:example:happs: npm run build:happ && npm run build:happ:clone && npm run build:happ:tasker && bash scripts/ts-bindings-example.sh
scripts.build:cell-proxy: bash scripts/ts-bindings.sh && npm run build -w packages/cell-proxy
scripts.build:packages: npm run build:cell-proxy && npm run build -w packages/lit-happ && npm run build -w packages/we-utils && npm run build:profiles && npm run build:agent-directory && npm run build:shared-ownership && npm run build:path-explorer
scripts.devtest: npm run clean:hc && npm run build:example:happs && npm run build:packages && npm run start
scripts.devtest:clone: npm run clean:hc && npm run build:example:happs && npm run build:packages && npm run start:clone
scripts.devtest:we: npm run clean:hc && npm run build:example:happs && npm run build:packages && npm run build:ui -w playgrounds/webapp && npm run start:we
scripts.devtest:tasker: npm run clean:hc && npm run build:example:happs && npm run build:packages && npm run start:tasker
scripts.dist:we: npm run build:ui -w we-applet && npm run package:we
scripts.package:we: rm -rf artifacts/playground-we_applet-ui.zip & cd playgrounds/we-applet/dist && rm -f *.map && bestzip ../../../artifacts/playground-we_applet-ui.zip * && cd ../../../ && hc web-app pack playgrounds/webhapp.workdir -o artifacts/playground-we_applet.webhapp
scripts.prodtest:we: BOOT_PORT=$(port) SIGNAL_PORT=$(port) concurrently "npm run serve:run" "AGENT_NUM=1 npm run prodtest:we-launch"
scripts.prodtestfull:we: npm run build:happ && npm run build:packages && npm run build:ui -w playgrounds/webapp && npm run build:ui -w we-applet && npm run package:we && npm run prodtest:we
scripts.publish:cell: npm run build:cell-proxy && cd packages/cell-proxy && npm publish
scripts.publish:lit: npm run build -w packages/lit-happ && cd packages/lit-happ && npm publish
scripts.publish:we: npm run build -w packages/we-utils && cd packages/we-utils && npm publish
scripts.publish:agent-directory: npm run build -w dvms/agent-directory && cd dvms/agent-directory && npm publish
scripts.publish:path-explorer: npm run build -w dvms/path-explorer && cd dvms/path-explorer && npm publish
scripts.publish:profiles: npm run build -w dvms/profiles && cd dvms/profiles && npm publish
scripts.publish:shared: npm run build -w dvms/shared-ownership && cd dvms/shared-ownership && npm publish
scripts.publish:all: npm run publish:cell && npm run publish:lit && npm run publish:we && npm run publish:profiles && npm run publish:shared && npm run publish:agent-directory && npm run publish:path-explorer
